name: Game drive
description: Morning or afternoon 4x4 game drive for Big Five viewing.

name: Maasai village visit
description: Guided visit to a Maasai manyatta with cultural explanation and dance.

name: Hot air balloon safari
description: Dawn balloon flight over the reserve followed by a bush breakfast.

name: Elephant herds
description: Large elephant families on the Amboseli swamps with Kilimanjaro as backdrop.

name: Observation Hill
best_time: Year-round; clearest Kilimanjaro views at dawn
description: Panoramic lookout over the park, wetlands, and Mount Kilimanjaro.

name: Lake Nakuru flamingos and rhinos
description: Shores of Lake Nakuru for flamingos, both rhino species, and Rothschild giraffe.

name: Lake Naivasha boat ride
description: Boat safari for hippos, fish eagles, and shoreline birdlife.

name: Mzima Springs
description: Crystal springs with underwater hippo and fish viewing in Tsavo West.

name: Red elephants of Tsavo
description: Dust-red elephants along the Galana River in Tsavo East.

name: Serengeti endless plains
description: Open-plain game viewing and seasonal wildebeest migration routes.

name: Ngorongoro Crater descent
description: Full-day crater floor game drive among dense Big Five populations.

name: Lake Manyara game drive
description: Groundwater forest, tree-climbing lions, and flamingo-lined soda lake.

name: Maasai Mara National Reserve
description: Kenya's finest wildlife sanctuary, with well over 450 recorded species and resident wildlife year-round in addition to the seasonal migration.

name: Great Wildebeest Migration
description: Over a million wildebeest and zebra cross the Mara plains and the Mara River during the migration, drawing predators and dramatic river crossings.

name: Maasai Village (Manyatta) Visit
description: Guided visit to a local Maasai village to learn about traditional homes, customs, and dances. Optional add-on, bookable in advance.

name: Hot Air Balloon Safari
description: Sunrise hot air balloon float over the Mara plains for an aerial view of the wildlife and landscape, typically followed by a bush breakfast. Optional add-on, extra cost.

name: Guided Nature Walk
description: Walking excursion near camp led by a guide, covering local flora, animal tracks, and bird life. Optional add-on.

name: Hell's Gate National Park
description: Renowned for dramatic cliffs, gorges, geothermal features, hot springs and steam vents. One of the few Kenyan parks where visitors can walk or cycle among wildlife, including zebra, buffalo, antelope, and rare vultures and eagles. Fischer's Tower (climbing) and Olkaria Geothermal Spa are nearby.

name: Crescent Island Game Sanctuary
description: Private, predator-free wildlife sanctuary on Lake Naivasha reached by boat, known for close walking safaris among giraffe, zebra, waterbuck and antelope, plus strong birdwatching.

name: Lake Naivasha Boat Ride
description: Boat ride on Lake Naivasha, often combined with a Crescent Island visit.

name: David Sheldrick Wildlife Trust Nairobi Nursery
description: Elephant and rhino orphanage supporting Kenya's conservation work; the public visiting hour lets guests watch and learn about the hand-reared orphans.

name: Giraffe Centre (AFEW)
description: Conservation centre for the endangered Rothschild's giraffe, with a raised platform allowing visitors to feed and interact with giraffes up close.

name: Lake Nakuru Rhino Sanctuary & Bird Watching
description: Game drive around the alkaline lake for flamingos, pelicans and other water birds, plus a dedicated black and white rhino sanctuary. Waterbuck, impala, buffalo and gazelle are found in the surrounding gardens.
